verdict.rationale: Bento's docs explicitly define Segments as saved filters combining tags, fields (profile attributes), and events/behavior, with dynamic live membership: "When someone meets the criteria, they're automatically included. When they no longer match, they're automatically removed" [bento-docs-42], backed by a custom segment builder with unlimited conditions/filters [bento-docs-26], filtering by tags/segment/date ranges [bento-docs-8], and event tracking to fuel behavioral segmentation [bento-docs-27, bento-docs-39]. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of segment update latency/live behavior beyond vendor docs.
